task_title: OBS-OB-001 — minimal viable Prometheus emission: GET /metrics/prom with 5 obo_* series via client_golang+promhttp on a private registry
task_criteria: GET /metrics/prom returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/plain; version=0.0.4 and >=5 obo_* metric families: obo_http_up, obo_cron_loop_running, obo_solves_total{outcome}, obo_queue_pending, obo_solve_duration_seconds{outcome}
obo_queue_pending equals /api/v1/stats .queue_depth, and obo_solves_total/obo_solve_duration_seconds are wired from internal/cron loop Metrics (no longer dead code)

go build ./... ; go vet ./... ; go test ./internal/api/ ./internal/cron/ ./internal/metrics/ all pass, with a new test that parses the exposition via expfmt.TextParser and asserts zero malformed lines

tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ GET /metrics/prom returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/plain; version=0.0.4 and >=5 obo_* metric families: obo_http_up, obo_cron_loop_running, obo_solves_total{outcome}, obo_queue_pending, obo_solve_duration_seconds{outcome}: internal/api/server.go:142 registers `mux.HandleFunc("GET /metrics/prom", s.handleMetricsProm)`; server.go:354 serves `s.Prom.Handler()` (promhttp, nil-receiver-safe). internal/metrics/prom.go NewProm builds a private `prometheus.NewRegistry()` with all five families: obo_http_up (GaugeFunc=1), obo_cron_loop_running (GaugeFunc), obo_solves_total{outcome} (custom collector, succeeded/failed/rejected), obo_queue_pending (custom collector), obo_solve_duration_seconds HistogramVec{outcome}. cmd/off-by-one/main.go:308 routes /metrics/prom to apiHandler so the SPA catch-all cannot answer it. Test output: `--- PASS: TestMetricsPromEndpoint` (asserts 200, Content-Type prefix `text/plain; version=0.0.4`, all 5 families, rejects HTML body), `--- PASS: TestMetricsPromNilSafe` (asserts `obo_http_up 1`, `obo_cron_loop_running 0`, `obo_solves_total{outcome="succeeded"} 0`, `obo_queue_pending 0`, `obo_solve_duration_seconds_bucket`), `--- PASS: TestMetricsPromReadOnlyPassthrough`, `--- PASS: TestPromExpositionFamiliesAndPartition`.
  ✓ obo_queue_pending equals /api/v1/stats .queue_depth, and obo_solves_total/obo_solve_duration_seconds are wired from internal/cron loop Metrics (no longer dead code): obo_queue_pending source is `queue.Depth(ctx)` in both internal/api/server.go:105-110 (New default) and cmd/off-by-one/main.go:250-254; /api/v1/stats sets `st.QueueDepth = depth` from the same `s.Queue.Depth` (internal/api/handlers.go:867-868; ingest/queue.go:646 same SQL). TestMetricsPromEndpoint (internal/api/metrics_prom_test.go:64-78) asserts obo_queue_pending == stats.queue_depth — PASS. obo_solves_total wired from `loop.Metrics().Snapshot()` (main.go:255-264); obo_solve_duration_seconds wired via `loop.Metrics().SetDurationObserver(prom.ObserveSolveDuration)` (main.go:269), with cron/loop.go:155-167 SetDurationObserver/observeDuration invoked from recordSuccess/recordFailure/recordRejection (loop.go:175,184,199) — previously-dead counters now exposed. Test output: `--- PASS: TestMetricsDurationObserver`, `--- PASS: TestMetricsDurationObserverNilAndUnset`.
  ✓ the existing JSON GET /metrics is byte-compatible: same keys/types, jq -e .skipped_host_pressure succeeds: internal/metrics/metrics.go is NOT modified by the commit (`git show --name-only HEAD | grep -c internal/metrics/metrics.go` = 0); Snapshot keys/types unchanged (metrics.go:219-250, `SkippedHostPressure int64 \`json:"skipped_host_pressure"\``). handleMetrics (server.go:338-344) still `writeJSON(w, 200, s.Observer.Snapshot())`. Test output: `--- PASS: TestHandleMetricsReturnsSnapshot`, `--- PASS: TestHandleMetricsEmptyObserver`, `--- PASS: TestHandleMetricsNilObserver`, `--- PASS: TestMetricsJSONUnchangedAfterProm` (asserts application/json + skipped_host_pressure present as a number). jq present at /usr/bin/jq; `echo '{"solve_count":0,"skipped_host_pressure":0}' | jq -e .skipped_host_pressure` → `0`, JQ_EXIT=0.
  ✓ go build ./... ; go vet ./... ; go test ./internal/api/ ./internal/cron/ ./internal/metrics/ all pass, with a new test that parses the exposition via expfmt.TextParser and asserts zero malformed lines: Fresh runs: `go build ./...` exit 0; `go vet ./...` exit 0; `go test -count=1 ./internal/api/ ./internal/cron/ ./internal/metrics/` exit 0 → `ok .../internal/api 0.865s`, `ok .../internal/cron 0.122s`, `ok .../internal/metrics 0.006s` (full `go test -count=1 ./...` also exit 0, 15 pkgs ok; gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/ empty). New test internal/metrics/prom_test.go parseProm() uses `expfmt.NewTextParser(model.LegacyValidation).TextToMetricFamilies(...)` and `t.Fatalf("exposition has malformed lines: %v", err)` on any parse error; it is exercised by TestPromExpositionFamiliesAndPartition, TestPromNilSafeZeroExposition and TestPromQueuePendingSourceErrorOmitsSeries — all `--- PASS`.
All four criteria verified: /metrics/prom serves 200 with text/plain; version=0.0.4 and the five obo_* families on a private registry, queue/solve series are wired from queue.Depth and cron loop Metrics, JSON /metrics is unchanged, and build/vet/tests (including the expfmt.TextParser zero-malformed-lines test) all pass.
